candidates.summary: No test sends a duplicated public key, so gnark's AddMixed doubling branch, reached by bls12381.go:57 when the running sum equals the next key, has zero hits under the package's tests
candidates.failure_scenario: Ethereum sync committees are sampled with possible duplicates, so a real committee can carry the same key twice, leading [pk, pk, ...] included. That shape makes agg.AddMixed(&pk) at bls12381.go:57 take gnark's p == a path (g1.go:460-461, DoubleMixed), the branch an incomplete addition formula gets wrong. Today it is right: [pk,pk] with sig 2*sk*H(m) verifies true. But a gnark-crypto bump that broke it would leave every test green while valid sync-committee updates with a leading duplicate fail, or the wrong sum passes. The same untested branch is reached by FastAggregateVerifyExcluding at bls12381.go:98 when an excluded key equals minus the running sum.
candidates.verify_by: cd gnovm/stdlibs/crypto/bls12381 && go test -run '^(TestFastAggregateVerify|TestFastAggregateVerifyExcluding)$' -timeout 2m -coverpkg=github.com/consensys/gnark-crypto/ecc/bls12-381 -coverprofile=c.out . && grep 'bls12-381/g1.go:460.38' c.out  (expect count 0); then TestTopic3Determinism in tests/topic3-determinism-builds_test.go, case dup2, gives count 1 and true
candidates.evidence: existing tests: 'github.com/consensys/gnark-crypto/ecc/bls12-381/g1.go:460.38,462.3 1 0'; with dup2/dup3/excl==-agg added: 'g1.go:460.38,462.3 1 1', all expected verdicts pass

Every build printed 'DIGEST 4f9b8674157603753c70d0693e074238a77c934df5c392301f57930ffe0f6247 cases=504': default (Ryzen 7840HS, ADX+AVX-512), -tags noadx, -tags purego, GOARCH=386, and GOARCH=arm64 under qemu-aarch64

dropped.summary: goroutines or shared mutable state in the reached gnark path (ethDST, negG1Gen, gnark globals) race when queries run natives concurrently with block execution
dropped.settled_by: go test -race -run TestTopic3Concurrent (16 goroutines x 4 calls of both natives) printed 'ok ... 1.054s'. In ecc/bls12-381, grep finds parallel.Execute only in isInSubGroupBatchG1Naive/Prob, BatchJacobianToAffineG1, isInSubGroupBatchG2*, partitionScalars/MSM and the Decoder (marshal.go:284,349). The 'go func' hits are only in fp/vector.go, and none of these is reached. ethDST has spare capacity (43 bytes, 48 class), so an append inside ExpandMsgXmd would have raced, and none did

dropped.summary: a crafted key or signature panics inside gnark decode, hash-to-curve or pairing, handing the VM a Go panic
dropped.settled_by: marshal.go:895-990 (G1) and 1162-1276 (G2) return an error for every bad shape: ErrShortBuffer for 0b000/0b010 masks in a 48/96-byte slot, ErrInvalidEncoding for 0b001/0b011/0b111, ErrInvalidInfinityEncoding, a SetBytesCanonical error for x >= p, a nil Sqrt or Legendre == -1, and a subgroup error. HashToG2 errors only for a DST over 255 bytes, and PairingCheck only on a length mismatch. 200 random inputs across all 8 mask values ran through both natives with no panic
